svg.title: Bradycardia decision chart: a battery problem (sinus node dysfunction, too few P waves), a wiring problem (first-degree, Mobitz I, Mobitz II or complete AV block, P waves without QRS) or bundle branch block; each column gives the ECG, the risk, and whether to pace for mortality, for symptoms, or not at all
